sections.title: Making an idea real is a good kind of happiness
paragraphs: I enjoy programming, and I care about how an interface looks and how a feature feels to use. Making something work and making it feel right belong together.
This is where I leave traces of experiments: a small project, a stubborn question finally untangled, or an unfinished thought that deserves a page of its own.

sections.title: There is a person on the other side of the code
paragraphs: I'm an INFJ, though I'd rather be known through these little records than four letters. A piece of music, a sentence in a book, or an idea from a walk belongs here too.
We can talk about code, trade a book or song recommendation, or simply share something about today. Finding someone willing to have an unhurried conversation online is already a nice thing.

content.title: A few fragments of everyday life
content.intro: This is adnaan's personal blog. Some pages are for technology, others for life. There is also a coastline, and a not-very-busy otter.

sections.title: Why “Fragments of Time”?
paragraphs: Once a moment has passed, it can be hard to remember it whole. A paragraph or a photograph leaves a small copy of who we were at the time.
Not everything here needs a lesson. Something finished, something that failed, or simply a good song on an ordinary day can all have a page.

sections.title: A coastline and an otter, just because
paragraphs: Paper, pencil lines, and a warm sunset set the tone. Alongside the writing, I wanted somewhere a visitor could pause for a moment.
So there is a coastline, and an otter to watch over it. They won't choose your reading for you. If you don't feel like reading, take a little walk along the shore.

sections.title: A record that keeps changing
paragraphs: Articles hold longer questions; notes keep smaller thoughts. Projects trace the making, and photographs collect places where I stopped to look.
The site will change as I do. Thank you for stopping on one of its pages and giving something written alone a reader on the other side.
